create.name: Mellissa Seaman
create.bio:
Mellissa Seaman is an intuitive teacher and mentor who trained as a lawyer before turning to spiritual work. After studying at Stanford and taking a law degree in San Diego, she practised business law until the birth of her daughter in 2000 opened what she describes as a sudden intuitive awakening. She went on to train in several forms of bodywork and was taken in, trained and ordained by Maria Yraceburu, a ceremonial elder of the Tlish Diyan tradition. She lives on a forested property near Nevada City in the Sierra foothills of California.

Through Channel Your Genius she teaches people, many of them professionals and business owners, to develop their intuition, work with spirit guides and name their particular gifts, using her own Soul Gift system of archetypes. Her Activation Circle runs as an online mystery school with weekly masterclasses, seasonal day retreats and a course library, while her mentorship programmes pair channelled guidance with practical help on purpose, expertise and how to present one's work. She also offers short self-paced courses, one-to-one sessions and intensive clarity days, and posts regular talks on YouTube about guides, archetypes, nature spirits and feminine wisdom.

courses.title: Channel Your Genius Activation Circle
courses.description: An online membership for intuitive development, with a live masterclass each Tuesday, day-long online retreats each quarter, a library of video courses and a members' forum.

courses.title: Channel Your Genius Leaders Mentorship
courses.description: A monthly mentoring programme for people running purpose-led businesses, combining weekly group calls and private clearing and coaching sessions with practical help on writing and reach.

courses.title: Genius Revealer
courses.description: A short self-paced course in her Soul Gift system: three quizzes on your gifts, role and type of genius, then a guided meditation and reflection on your life's turning points to draw out a sense of purpose.

courses.title: VIP Business Clarity Session
courses.description: A four-hour one-to-one intensive that combines an intuitive reading of your gifts and purpose with a plan for the shape, pricing and wording of your work.

free_resources.title: Soul Gift Quiz
free_resources.description: A free online quiz that sorts you into one of the soul gift archetypes she uses in her teaching, with notes on what that gift suggests.

free_resources.title: Channel Your Genius Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of talks and conversations on intuition, spirit guides and purpose-led work.
